fixes_applied.issue: Incompatible dependency versions causing CI/CD failures

changes.reason: Pydantic v1 uses @validator decorator, but code was using @field_validator from Pydantic v2. Updated to Pydantic v2 for compatibility with existing code. Also updated pytest for better stability.

fixes_applied.issue: pytest configuration error - wrong testpath directory

changes.reason: Tests directory is named 'tests' not 'test'. This prevented pytest from finding test files.

changes.content: Added .venv/, __pycache__/, *.pyc, .pytest_cache/, and other standard Python ignore patterns

root_cause_analysis.description: The codebase was written for Pydantic v2 (using @field_validator decorator) but requirements.txt specified Pydantic v1.10.2. The validator.py file imports and uses @field_validator which only exists in Pydantic v2.
root_cause_analysis.description_secondary: The pytest.ini file specified 'testpaths = test' but the actual directory is named 'tests', causing pytest to fail finding test files.

notes: All tests now pass successfully. The workspace is ready for CI/CD execution. Run 'python run_ci.py' from the issue_fixed directory to verify.
